<USER_REQUEST>
Create an enemy-mob-32 sprite named "Bellows Imp".

Creative brief
Name: Bellows Imp
Collection: Ashforge Remnants. Abandoned forge creatures and half-living constructs powered by coals, slag, chains, soot, and unstable furnace heat.
Core concept: A mobile pressure attacker that pushes projectiles outward with blasts of heated air.
Body and silhouette: Small hunched imp with a leathery bellows torso, thin limbs, and a nozzle-shaped mouth.
Signature features: Accordion body folds, iron handle on its back, and ember-lit cheeks.
Palette and materials: Soot black, scorched leather brown, dull brass, and hot orange.
Movement personality: Fidgety, mischievous, and constantly compressing.
Attack concept: Expands before releasing a wide cone of slow cinders that accelerate as they travel away.
Directional details: One brass handle is attached only on the right side of its back.
Avoid: Red devil stereotype, bat wings, modern mechanical blower.
</USER_REQUEST>
